technology_name: Smart Traffic Signal System for Emergency Vehicle Priority
institution: KSCSTE - National Transportation Planning and Research Centre (NATPAC)
problem_solved: Traffic congestion delays at urban signal junctions that prolong emergency vehicle response times during life-critical windows.
description: An Emergency Vehicle Priority System (EVPS) developed in collaboration with KELTRON that dynamically grants right-of-way to emergency vehicles. The system utilizes real-time GPS coordinates mapped to specific junction arms. When an ambulance entering the zone is detected, the vehicle unit communicates with the intersection controller to trigger a pre-emptive "hurry call" sequence, overriding standard signal cycles to clear traffic ahead of the vehicle.
applications:
• Municipal Smart City infrastructure upgrades and traffic control networks

• Centralized emergency vehicle fleet management and tracking systems

• Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS) commercial signaling hardware installations

• Prioritized transit routing systems for fire, rescue, and public safety fleets
